messages:
maya: Postmortem for INC-4321 is up: https://redwood.pm/pm/INC-4321. Main follow-ups are alert tuning + ownership. Short summary: noisy latency alerts during cache warmup, duplicate pages from slightly different alert labels, and thresholds that don't account for bursty jobs. Can folks grab owners?

oncall-bot: Incident INC-4321 P0 closed. Postmortem uploaded by maya.

jon: I can take the dedupe/grouping work. Will audit alert labels and propose a regex-based grouping to ignore ephemeral pod ids. ETA EOD Wed.

sam: I can own threshold tuning. Need the actual alert query + some sample histograms to pick p95/p99. maya, can you paste the alert rule?

maya: Pasted the prod rule below:
```
avg_over_time(request_latency[5m]) > 200
```
We think 200ms is too low for cold-start bursts.

lisa: For paging policy, suggest: page on 5min sustained breach OR >3 occurrences in 10min. That should cut down alert storms. I'm happy to update the runbook.

jon: During quick triage I noticed two alerts identical except for the pod id tag. Proposing group by (service, region) and drop pod_id from grouping key. Will open PR against alerting repo.

sam: Threshold proposal: prod p95 > 300ms AND p99 > 700ms. Staging keep lower but route to #devops-noisy only. Also add an automated smoke check after deploy to avoid immediate pages.

tj: @sam SGTM on p95/p99. Also recommend an initial suppression window of 2m after a deploy to avoid deployment-triggered noise.

maya: Action items (assigning now):
- jon -> dedupe/grouping rules (ticket #5432)
- sam -> threshold changes + tests (ticket #5433)
- lisa -> runbook + paging policy update (ticket #5434)
I'll own validation plan and rollback steps. Can we agree on due dates so SRE can close the postmortem?

jon: Ticket #5432 assigned to me, due 2026-03-26. I'll link the PR & test logs.

sam: I'll create #5433 and set due 2026-03-24. Will add alert unit tests and perf histograms.

lisa: Runbook ticket #5434 created, due 2026-03-28. I'll add clear paging criteria + checklist for on-call.

maya: Perfect. Let's reconvene in one week to verify noise reduced and check for recurrence patterns. Also propose adding a recurring monthly review to the on-call cadence to catch slowly recurring incidents.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: alert-tuning-review in 7 days (2026-03-31) — posted by maya.

jon: :thumbsup: I'll post the grouping PR link when ready and ping here.

sam: Thanks all — once thresholds are live I'll run a dry-run alert to track false-positive rate for 48h.

lisa: I'll update the runbook and add a note to the postmortem with links to the tickets.

maya: Thanks team. Closing the loop: owners set, due dates set, monthly follow-up added. If anyone hits blockers ping me or @oncall.
